stem: To measure what marketing emails add, an analyst uses the customers with no email address on file as the holdout. What is the problem?

options.text: None: any group that gets no emails works as a holdout for measuring them
That group was not chosen at random and likely buys differently from the rest
The holdout is too large, so the business loses too much revenue from it
Customers without an email address cannot buy online, so their revenue is always 0
